task: Make mark-review-pass.py accept only ASCII-digit PR numbers and test the refusal of non-numeric input (narwhal#312)

events.summary: The PR-number guard used argv[1].isdigit(), which accepts Unicode digits such as the superscript two; replacing the guard with True left the existing suite green, so non-numeric input was untested

Replaced the isdigit() guard with re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", argv[1]) and added a MainTest case asserting exit 2 and zero gh calls for -1, 1e3, 12;id, superscript two, Arabic-Indic digits, empty, leading-space, trailing-space and trailing-newline PR numbers

scripts/ci/tests pass (35 tests); mutation check replacing the guard with True made the new test fail, then the guard was restored and the suite passed again; make validate, make test (289 passed, 0 failed) and shellcheck pass
mark-review-pass.py now rejects non-ASCII and non-numeric PR numbers before any gh call, covered by a mutation-checked test
Issue #312 items 1 and 2 addressed; the independent-review status is left to the independent reviewer
